headlines.title: I'll tell my players to dive in future - Iraola
headlines.description: Andoni Iraola says that he will tell his players to go down in future after Liverpool were denied a penalty in Sunday's defeat by Arsenal.

headlines.title: From Fleetwood embarrassment to 'magical' Anfield win 14 years in making
headlines.description: Arsenal bounce back from the low of defeat at League Two Fleetwood to secure their first win in 14 years at Anfield - and open up a three-point lead at the top of the Premier League.

headlines.title: Arsenal move clear at the top with a rare win at Liverpool
headlines.description: Arsenal win at Anfield for the first time since 2012 to earn a three-point lead at the top of the Premier League table following an end-to-end match that leaves Liverpool frustrated to have taken nothing.
